title: 第21章 属下参见魔后第22章 惹祸系统巧献奸计
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
【宿主，你能也给她一巴掌吗？】
【我受不了了，她不知道你忙着去打涂辞珩吗，在这碍什么事啊】
本来对于蓝莘针对昭杺柠，系统是没感觉的。
但现在蓝莘妨碍昭杺柠招惹男主的任务，系统就忍不了了。
所以系统一直在昭杺柠脑中催促她赶紧给蓝莘两耳光。
昭杺柠右手被钟离珟拉着，左手被蓝莘抓着，不管现在想打谁都没机会。
就这样，三个人直接被狐狸木雕爆发出的吸引拖拽进了星辰境。
一阵天旋地转，昭杺柠降落在一片草地，双手也恢复了自由。
在进入星辰境之前，原本拉着她的钟离珟和蓝莘，此刻都消失不见了。
“诶嘿，我自由了。”没看见这两人，昭杺柠第一反应是高兴。
毕竟钟离珟盯她跟盯犯人一样。
一开始昭杺柠还苦恼进了星辰境怎么单独行动去找涂辞珩。
没想到进入星辰境的传送，自带拆散人的功能。
“系统，继续导航涂辞珩的坐标。”昭杺柠心道。
【好呢！】
见昭杺柠积极做任务，系统也是激动。
【正在搜索涂辞珩坐标位置，请宿主耐心等待】
等待系统给导航的期间，昭杺柠看了看周围环境。
她掉落的这块草地不远处就是森林，里面树木密布，偶有阳光穿过叶缝洒落金芒。
一处灌木丛中，突然发出窸窸窣窣的声音。

昭杺柠盯着灌木丛一脸戒备，就见蓝莘甩着脑袋从里面爬了出来。
蓝莘一看见昭杺柠那一刻，眸色顿时亮了。
甚至像是饿了许久的狼看见了羊，眸中全是凶狠跟激动。
“小师婶，你怎么一个人在这呀？”
蓝莘笑嘻嘻向昭杺柠走近，目光瞟着四周：“你的未婚夫呢？我们那尊敬的小师叔怎么没跟你一起啊。”
“不对劲……”看见向自己靠近，手握剑柄正要拔剑的蓝莘，昭杺柠顾不上多想，转身就跑。
“你别跑啊。”蓝莘直接拔剑一个灵力飞步，瞬间来到昭杺柠前面拦住了她，剑尖直指她喉咙，勾唇冷笑：“继续逃啊，不过一个凡人，你觉得你能逃掉吗？”
说完，蓝莘毫不废话，挥剑皆是杀招，全往昭杺柠心口和喉咙打去。
昭杺柠再次转身，直接往森林冲，蓝莘笑着追杀在后。
“不是吧蓝莘，我看出你跟钟离珟有仇了，但你跟他有仇你去杀他啊。”昭杺柠一边跑一边喊：“你杀我做什么。”
面对昭杺柠的问话，蓝莘并不受影响，又是一个灵力飞步，再次越到昭杺柠逃跑的前面拦住了她。
作为凡人，面对4星实力的蓝莘，昭杺柠承认自己确实连逃跑都显得很命苦。
但现在还不是使用星座庇护所的时候。
昭杺柠飞快看了眼自己目前拥有的三个表情包。
分别是哭笑脸，鸽子皇，超绿的。
超绿的明显对逃跑没用，哭笑脸总不可能真像系统之前说的，丢表情包对蓝莘求饶吧。
content_en:
[Host, can you give her a slap too? 】
[I can’t stand it anymore. Doesn’t she know that you are busy fighting Tu Ciheng? What are you doing here?]
Originally, the system had no idea that Lan Xin was targeting Zhao Hao Ning.
But now that Lan Xin is hindering Zhao Hao Ning's mission to provoke the male protagonist, the system can't bear it anymore.
So the system kept urging her to give Lan Xin a slap in the face in Zhao Hao Ning's mind.
Zhao Haining's right hand was held by Zhong Lizui, and his left hand was grabbed by Lan Xin. No matter who he wanted to hit now, he had no chance.
In this way, the three people were directly dragged into the star realm by the attraction erupted by the fox wood carving.
After a sudden spin, Zhao Hao Ning landed on a grassy field, and his hands were free again.
Before entering the Starry Realm, Zhong Lizui and Lan Xin, who were holding her, disappeared at this moment.
"Hey, I'm free." Zhao Hao Ning's first reaction was happiness when he didn't see these two people.
After all, Zhong Lizui stared at her like a prisoner.
At first, Zhao Haining was worried about how to go alone to find Tu Ciheng after entering the Star Realm.
Unexpectedly, the teleportation into the star realm has the function of breaking people apart.
"System, continue to navigate Tu Ciheng's coordinates." Zhaohu Ning thought to himself.
【Okay! 】
Seeing Zhao Hao Ning actively completing tasks, the system was also excited.
[Searching for the coordinates of Tu Ciheng, please wait patiently]
While waiting for navigation from the system, Zhao Hao Ning looked at the surrounding environment.
Not far from the grassland where she fell, there was a forest, which was densely covered with trees. Occasionally, the sun shone golden light through the gaps in the leaves.
A rustling sound suddenly came from a bush.
Zhao Hao Ning stared at the bushes with a wary expression, then saw Lan Xin crawling out of it, shaking her head.
The moment Lan Xin saw Zhao Hao Ning, her eyes suddenly lit up.
It was even like a wolf who had been hungry for a long time and saw the sheep, his eyes full of ferocity and excitement.
"Little Auntie, why are you here alone?"
Lan Xin walked towards Zhao Hao Ning with a smile and looked around: "Where is your fiancé? Why isn't our respected junior uncle with you?"
"Something's wrong..." Seeing Lan Xin approaching her, holding the hilt of the sword and about to draw it, Zhao Haining turned around and ran away without thinking too much.
"Don't run." Lan Xin drew her sword and took a spiritual leap. She was in front of Zhao Hao Ning and stopped her in an instant. The tip of the sword was pointed directly at her throat, and she sneered: "Keep running. I'm just a mortal. Do you think you can escape?"
After saying that, Lan Xin said nothing nonsense and swung her sword with killing moves, hitting Zhao Hao Ning's heart and throat.
Zhao Hao Ning turned around again and rushed straight into the forest, with Lan Xin chasing after her with a smile.
"No, Lan Xin, I see that you have a grudge against Zhong Lizui, but if you have a grudge against him, go ahead and kill him." Zhao Ning shouted as he ran, "Why are you killing me?"
Facing Zhao Hao Ning's questioning, Lan Xin was not affected, and with another spiritual flying step, she once again reached the front of Zhao Hao Ning's escape and stopped her.
As a mortal, facing Lan Xin with 4-star strength, Zhao Hao Ning admitted that it was indeed difficult for him to even escape.
But now is not the time to use Constellation Shelter.
Zhao Hao Ning quickly took a look at the three emoticons she currently owned.
They are Crying Smiling Face, Pigeon King, and Super Green.
The super green one is obviously useless for escaping. It's impossible for the crying and smiling face to be like what the system said before. Just throw an emoticon and beg Lan Xin for mercy.
